summary: We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Digitalization Specialist to join our Third Party Cyber Risk Management team. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in driving the development and optimization of our SureSTaRT tool, ensuring it meets current and future business needs.
responsibilities: Requirements Gathering: Work closely with stakeholders, users, and cross-functional teams to collect, analyze, and document business requirements for the SureSTaRT tool.
Technical Translation: Translate business requirements into clear, concise technical specifications to guide development efforts.
Collaboration with Developers: Partner with third-party developers to ensure the accurate and timely implementation of tool functionalities while maintaining quality standards.
Quality Assurance: Oversee testing and validation processes to ensure the delivered solutions meet requirements and function as expected.
Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify opportunities for enhancements or new capabilities within the SureSTaRT tool to improve user experience and meet evolving business needs.
Stakeholder Communication: Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, providing updates, addressing concerns, and ensuring alignment on project goals.
Documentation: Maintain detailed documentation of requirements, workflows, technical specifications, and implementation processes for future reference.
Project Management: Monitor timelines and progress, ensuring projects stay on track and within scope.
required_skills: 5+ years of experience in requirements gathering, technical documentation, and project management.
nice_to_have_skills: Experience with digitalization or automation projects is a plus.
Familiarity with tools or platforms similar to SureSTaRT is a plus.
benefits: Opportunities to work with a global team and lead a variety of innovative projects
Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave
Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform
